draft.text: You came in because you have had sharp, stabbing, or shooting pain on the right side of your face, especially around your cheekbone, for two months.
We did not find any numbness, tingling, weakness, or other symptoms on the affected side.
The pain seems to be triggered by cold air, touching the area, or certain sensory inputs, but it is not linked to chewing, speaking, or brushing your teeth.
You will be referred for further evaluation and management of the pain.
You will also be scheduled for a follow-up appointment to reassess the pain and adjust the management plan as needed.
